high_level_description: This image is a detailed black-and-white illustration that combines elements of fantasy and surrealism. The central figure is a large, majestic raven with intricate feather patterns and a sharp, curved beak. The raven appears to be in a state of flight or hovering, with its wings spread wide. In the background, there is a humanoid figure dressed in long, flowing robes, standing on a rocky surface. The figure is holding a staff or scepter in one hand and has a helmet-like headpiece. The robes are detailed with folds and textures, suggesting a sense of movement and depth.
